name: controller-restart
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B stops at 10 s and the route moves to D (epoch 1000, version 2). At 25 s the controller restarts with epoch 1001 and an empty view; its version numbers start again at 1. Nodes accept the newer epoch although 1 is smaller than 2, and delivery continues throughout.
